ana.rank.page.title: Ranking on several measures
ana.rank.page.subtitle: A unit is compared with units of a similar size on several measures; a unit held back by something outside its control carries a note that someone else approved; a figure under complaint is marked; the rate of disbursement always stands beside the physical progress.
ana.rank.context.unit: Unit: percent, count per project and points out of 100
ana.rank.gated.title: Indicator not certified
ana.rank.model.title: The measures and their weights
ana.rank.model.caveat: A composite score exists only when at least {min} measures have data; each measure is scaled 0 to 100 among the units of the same size band. A position is within the band only.
ana.rank.model.effectExclude: An approved note takes the measure it touches out of the composite; the figure itself is still shown.
ana.rank.model.effectShow: An approved note is shown beside the position and does not change the score.
ana.rank.band.title: Size band {band} (plan from {plan} dong)
ana.rank.band.thin: The band has only {count} units: the comparison is weak
ana.rank.table.caption: Each row is a unit with its position in the band, composite score, value and score of each measure, and the rate of disbursement beside the physical progress
ana.rank.excluded: (taken out of the score by a note)
ana.rank.na.notReadable: The figure could not be read.
ana.rank.na.tooFew: Too few measures have data, so the unit is not ranked.
ana.rank.na.noSnapshot: There is no frozen snapshot yet.
ana.rank.na.notCertified: The definition of the disbursement rate is not certified, so the ranking is not shown.
ana.rank.na.other: It cannot be computed because data is missing.
ana.rank.annotate.aria: Note that unit {unit} is held back outside its control
ana.rank.annotate.title: Propose a note of a hold-up outside the unit's control
ana.rank.annotate.maker: The note takes effect only after somebody else approves it.
ana.rank.annotate.done: The note was proposed; it waits for somebody else to approve it.
ana.rank.complain.title: Complain about a figure
ana.rank.complain.claim: What is wrong with the figure (at least 10 characters)
ana.rank.complain.claimed: The value the unit says is right (optional)
ana.rank.complain.done: The complaint was sent; the figure is marked as under complaint until it is answered.
ana.rank.problem.denied: You have no right over this unit.
ana.rank.problem.invalid: The content is not valid: check the cause, the measure, the day and the words.
ana.rank.problem.failed: It could not be sent; try again.
ana.rank.link.notes: Notes and complaints of the ranking
ana.rank.link.rate: Ranking by the rate of disbursement
ana.notes.page.title: Notes and complaints of the ranking
ana.notes.page.subtitle: A note that a unit is held back outside its control waits for somebody other than its author; a complaint about a figure is answered in words by somebody other than who filed it.
ana.notes.annotation.title: Notes of a hold-up outside control
ana.notes.annotation.caption: Each row is a note: unit, cause and evidence, measures, period, status, who proposed and who decided
ana.notes.complaint.title: Complaints about figures
ana.notes.complaint.caption: Each row is a complaint: unit, figure, content, status and the day an answer is due
ana.notes.maker: The author does not approve their own note.
ana.notes.filer: The person who filed does not answer.
ana.notes.dialog.correct: Record that the figure was corrected
ana.notes.problem.self: You do not approve or answer your own item.
ana.notes.problem.denied: You have no right over this.
ana.notes.problem.state: The status has changed, so it could not be done; reload the list.
ana.notes.problem.invalid: The content is not valid: an answer in words of enough length is needed.
ana.notes.problem.gone: The item is no longer in your scope.
ana.notes.problem.failed: It could not be done; try again.
ana.notes.link.ranking: Back to the ranking on several measures
